question: What powers arise in this stage of yogic practice?
premises: Knowledge of distant hearing is named
These are presented as attained results
inference: The practitioner gains knowledge of distant hearing and the power to paralyze bonds.
uncertainties: pāśa-stobham may mean paralysis of fetters or immobilization of enemies
plain_english: O beloved, one gains knowledge of distant hearing and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
